query: INSERT INTO central.command_receipts (id, workspace_id, command_scope, idempotency_key, input_fingerprint, expected_aggregate_versions, result_kind, result_reference, correlation_id, causation_id, expiry_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, clock_timestamp() + interval '7 days') ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, command_scope, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
